chunks: From him, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from some of his companions, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
It is appropriate for the one afflicted by a calamity to put down his cloak, so that people may know that he is one afflicted by the calamity.

key_terms.صَاحِبِ الْمُصِيبَةِ: the person afflicted by a calamity or bereavement

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended etiquette for a person affected by a calamity according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches an etiquette for a person suffering a bereavement or calamity: he should display a visible sign of grief so that people recognize his condition. It points to social awareness and appropriate communal conduct toward one experiencing loss.
